speech.heard: In South Africa, the richest fifth holds 59.5% of income. In Slovakia, it is 32.8%. South Africa has 1.8 times the share Slovakia does. It is the world's highest. This counts the share of income or consumption that flows to the top quintile. Slovakia is the world's lowest. The USA has 47.1%. China has 43.7%. Shares in South America are high, Colombia, 58.9%, Brazil, 55.4%, and Paraguay, 50.2%. India is low with 34.2%. Who holds the wealth where you live?
